headline: Claim Jameis Winston off waivers before tonight's 12:05 AM PT run — Jaxson Dart's knee injury looks season-ending, handing Winston the Giants' job long-term and making him a stronger QB3 claim than Mariota.
summary: Danny is 1-1 with Burrow and Geno Smith healthy locks at QB and SUPERFLEX, but Caleb Williams (hamstring) leaves the roster's third QB slot empty for at least a few weeks. Aaron Jones (knee) and Malik Nabers (shoulder) are true game-time decisions this Sunday, both already covered by auto-sub pairings that still need to be set in the Sleeper app. Tonight's waiver run is the moment to grab Winston, whose hold on New York's job just got much firmer than Washington's Mariota.

adds.why: Tier 2 bench insurance, not a starter for Danny this week (Burrow and Geno Smith start ahead of him); bid 9 of your 144.
adds.evidence: Giants coaching staff said Sep 22 that Jaxson Dart's knee injury is worse than first thought and could end his season, with Winston already making his second straight start; Danny's own QB3 Caleb Williams is out (hamstring, week-to-week per Bears coach Ben Johnson, Sep 22) with no eligible IR replacement, leaving his one open bench spot for a free-agent QB.

adds.why: Tier 3 fallback that only lands if the Winston claim loses; bid 5 of your 144, well under the Winston bid so it never outbids it.
adds.evidence: Washington HC Dan Quinn confirmed Sep 21-22 Jayden Daniels dislocated his elbow (no fracture) and is expected back later this season, so Mariota's hold on the starting job is shorter-lived than Winston's; same open bench spot.

subs.why: Nabers is Questionable (shoulder popped out Sep 21 vs Rams, X-rays pending) and both players kick off Sun 10:00 AM PT, so set the pair before then.
Jones is Questionable (knee, tweaked Sep 20 vs Bears, team optimistic) and Judkins carries near-identical volume as Cleveland's own RB1; both kick off Sun 10:00 AM PT, so set the pair before then.

alerts.title: ➕ Claim Winston before tonight's run
alerts.body: Place a waiver claim on QB Jameis Winston (bid 9) before the 12:05 AM PT run tonight — Jaxson Dart's knee injury looks season-ending, making Winston New York's QB1 long-term and filling your open bench spot while Caleb Williams is out.
